It's essentially a stick.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 4 |durability = 8 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Boko Club}} Boko Clubs are commonly found and dropped by red [[Bokoblin]]s throughout [[Hyrule]], especially on the [[Great Plateau]]. They are made by Bokoblins to hunt small prey, but due to a lack of refinement, they have low durability. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created and used by Bokoblins.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} The most common locations to find Boko Clubs is in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. They also have a chance to appear inside [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Being made of wood, Boko Clubs will burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Bokoblins often use this fact to deal additional Fire damage to [[Link]], using a [[Campfire]] to set their Clubs on Fire before attacking. Unlike metallic [[Weapon]]s, they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]], and they will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_004" |Life = 12 |Power = 4 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 5 |BuyingPrice = 9 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Bokoblin Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Artwork of a Bokoblin holding a Boko Club File:BotW Bokoblin Lighting Boko Club.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A Bokoblin lighting a Boko Club on Fire File:AoC Boko Club Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Boko Club File:AoC Bokoblin Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of a Bokoblin with a Boko Club ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bokoblin Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Clubs, Weapons, One-Handed Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
